method: librosa 0.11 / ffmpeg mono22050, STFT2048 hop256. Stem extraction inherited Demucs htdemucs; no new source separation. Envelopes normalized per-stem P95, not comparable calibrated dB. No human listening/lyric approval claimed.

bass.interpretation: Low-frequency pitch candidates only; harmonic/subharmonic errors possible. Bass RMS sustains drive continuous mass; attacks punctuation.

other.interpretation: Pitch-class/texture candidates, not chord labels or MIDI transcription; repeated bright texture permits graphic callbacks.
